notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Patch notes:

- Fixed  some menu things that weren't working well on controller or keyboard
- Pauses when controller is unplugged or disconnected

Officially the 3.0.1 build, this will be the release build for the 20th!

notes.title: New Update - Fixes and one new stuff
notes.content:
Patch Note:

- Added new hidden achievement (not a skin one).
- Fixed the player score leaderboard (was showing the wrong score at the top instead of yours).
- Fixed some other bugs.

Public release is just around the corner!
